output.reason: The changelog line [ev-c15ec21c6716] is vague by itself. The linked PR and commit [ev-0eb722a6455e][ev-45edf6d5d425] fill the gap. They name the subject as the `source` field of the Promtail drop stage. Before the fix, setting it to a YAML list of strings failed a type check and threw an error, because the list was read as `[]interface{}`. The fix converts that list to a string list so it is accepted. From this, an engineer can write the open aspects: configs whose drop stage `source` is a list are exposed, and they previously errored. Upgrading fixes this without any action from the operator. The changed files [ev-1a1f8a2c0571] are limited to drop.go and its test, so the change is confined to the drop stage.
